title: The life of Swamiji
description: His Holiness Sri Vidyanarayana Thirtha Swamiji has completed 52 Chaturmasyas. His life brings together spiritual practice, teaching and service: eight published spiritual books, satsangs and blessings, personal visits to students, and support for education and care.
